review_description: Sales/quoting process was really good.Installation went very smooth. There were 3 men and a female and they were very polite. Introduced themselves and spot on time. They were very clean. No mess at all. The customer service organised the grid connection and the installers spent time with us setting up our phones to the system and showing us all the ins and outs of the system. Will definitely recommend them.
